ARCHITECTURE.TITLE: Cloud & System Architecture
ARCHITECTURE.SUBTITLE: Designed for enterprise scalability, security, and velocity on Google Cloud Platform.
ARCHITECTURE.DB_DESC: Managed automated backups, high availability, point-in-time recovery
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR1_DESC1: Standalone Components: Zero NgModules, lean bundle sizes, and optimal tree-shaking.
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR1_DESC2: Angular Signals: Fine-grained reactivity without over-triggering change detection.
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR1_DESC3: Hardened Nginx: Multi-stage Docker build serving static assets with gzip, SPA fallback, and security headers.
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR2_DESC1: NestJS Clean Architecture: Controllers, Services, DTOs, and global exception filters.
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR2_DESC2: Class Validation: Strict payload validation with class-validator.
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR2_DESC3: OpenAPI / Swagger: Built-in interactive documentation at /api/docs.
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR3_DESC1: Type-safe ORM: Prisma schema with automatic migrations and client generation.
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR3_DESC2: Cloud SQL Connector: Native Unix socket connection (/cloudsql/INSTANCE) avoiding public IP exposure.
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR3_DESC3: Zero Downtime Migrations: prisma migrate deploy runs via Cloud Build before traffic switch.
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR4_DESC1: Serverless Scale-to-Zero: Pay only for requests, handling traffic spikes seamlessly.
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR4_DESC2: Terminus Health Probes: Native liveness and readiness probes checking database ping.
ARCHITECTURE.PILLAR4_DESC3: Least Privilege IAM: Service account with Cloud SQL Client and Secret Accessor roles only.
